masterVipSource.verification: ChatGPT Library original checked; WHY = reason, HOW = manner

en.questionFunction: WHY asks for reason, not manner
en.originQuestion: Why do you prefer the fresh cheese?
en.originReason: Because the fresh, mild cheese pairs well with the salmon.
en.transferQuestion: Why are we preparing this dinner together?
en.transferReason: Because preparing it together lets us share the experience.
en.notes: Fresh cheese referent made explicit; reason shifts from food pairing to shared activity.

es.questionFunction: POR QUÉ pide la razón, no el modo
es.originReason: Porque el queso fresco y suave combina bien con el salmón.
es.transferQuestion: ¿Por qué estamos preparando esta cena juntos?
es.transferReason: Porque prepararla juntos nos permite compartir la experiencia.

pt.questionFunction: POR QUE solicita a razão, não o modo
pt.originQuestion: Por que você prefere o queijo fresco?
pt.originReason: Porque o queijo fresco e suave combina bem com o salmão.
pt.transferQuestion: Por que estamos preparando este jantar juntos?
pt.transferReason: Porque prepará-lo juntos nos permite compartilhar essa experiência.
pt.notes: 'Prepará-lo' retoma 'o jantar' (masculino); a mudança de razão não depende de avaliar WHICH.

judgment.semanticDistinction: Ingredient-preference and collaborative-preparation are two distinguishable reasons in separate scenes; candidate for testing transfer of causal question use, NOT automatically proof of transfer.
limitations: Difference of IDs or scene labels is not proof of acquired skill
Two visible alternatives yield chance-performance risk; design independent response evidence before scoring
A learner hearing or selecting exploration LINES cannot mint evidence
No PAST/FUTURE or PERIOD evidence is authorized from present-only presentation
judgment.nextGate: Approve response task for each context, distractors, independent transfer requirements, multilingual and human review before contract v2
